headline: Colombia Proposes Slashing Income Tax Nearly in Half for New Tourism Investments
summary: The Colombian government announced a new tax framework that would nearly halve the corporate income tax rate for new investments in tourism, amid hotel occupancy declines from 58.4% to 50.6%.
why: Colombia has prioritized expanding non-oil revenue sources. Targeted corporate tax reductions aim to stimulate foreign direct investment and revitalize hospitality infrastructure.

impacts.name: Colombian Hospitality & Tourism
impacts.why: Lower tax rates improve expected project returns for hotel and resort developers.
